extraction.Name: Louis Mousseau
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want same, as he did not want to pay taxes on it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged to Bank of Interior, of Interior, South Dakota, in the spring of 1920, for the sum of $900.00, as he wanted to make improvements on his place
extraction.Buyer: Bank of Interior, of Interior, South Dakota, for $900.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: did not want same, as he did not want to pay taxes on it
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms a little, but his step son mostly supports him and his family
extraction.NOTES: Allotment is the SW¼ of Sec. 20, T. 40N., R. 38W., of the 6th P.M., in South Dakota; received a forced patent; the status of this quarter of land, together with the rest of his allotment is in such a muddle that he cannot make an intelligent statement regarding it; did not sell his allotment for any debts incurred prior to receiving his patent in fee; mentally incompetent, has poor health; has a wife and one child to support, the wife having poor health too; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn April 6, 1929
